complete_examples.text: However, WRRN holds strong randomicity and time–frequency characteristics because of the uncertainty of wheel–rail surface roughness and acoustic radiation, the deterministic analysis of WRRN needs to be further developed to meet the high demand of railway noise prediction, e.g., extremum estimation of WRRN.
Besides, the Sato spectrum [30] is introduced as the wheel–rail surface roughness of the short-wave excitation source.
